Welcome to the PHIRE Jupyter Book.

This site will document planning, data exploration, and analysis for the project, starting with preliminary work on Henry Ice Rise.

Henry Ice Rise sits within the Ronne Ice Shelf, West Antarctica. This notebook will build up a map of the ice rise using elevation data from the Reference Elevation Model of Antarctica (REMA), accessed with 

pdemtools, alongside standard geospatial Python tools (xarray, rioxarray, geopandas, matplotlib, cartopy).

This is currently a placeholder page. Planned next steps:

Define the Henry Ice Rise area of interest (bounding box or shapefile).

Use pdemtools to fetch/clip the REMA mosaic over the area of interest.

Produce a first map of surface elevation.
